scope: Exact unchanged canonical authored initial snapshot only

source_refs.limit: Natural-layer source presence and visual_initial_state are not transferred to entities.

source_refs.selector: canonical initial composition and runtime profile bindings

canonical_binding.runtime_entity_binding: Use exact committed entity_placements for each materialized NPC; compatibility anchor is not position evidence. A slot authorizes neither NPC existence nor visibility.

perception_owner.geometry: Committed active positions, G6, explicit visibility links and current portal states
perception_owner.light_weather_observer: Existing initial-state guard and exact approved Temporal/actor inputs
perception_owner.rule: Resolve every actual entity with its own factual stable_cover, dynamic_occlusion and concealment. Missing data is a typed gap. Same G6, position or anchor does not supply these conditions.

item_boundary.own_carried_items: Existing safe inventory projection may expose known owned/held garments from committed Stage 16 placements.
item_boundary.other_actor_equipment: Requires the holder's admitted perception and the item's actual exterior placement/access state; no automatic identity or contents disclosure.
item_boundary.ground_items: Require exact committed placement and their own current visual source conditions. No stock class is an item instance.

missing_owner_inputs: Exact current per-entity stable_cover, dynamic_occlusion and concealment from an authoritative state owner or separately approved authored initial entity state
Player-safe full and partial appearance/recognition facts; objective NPC name, role, origin, activity or intention does not establish player knowledge
Current source admission for ground items and visible exterior equipment

review_request.scope: Exact applicability and unresolved source boundary only; this candidate cannot authorize runtime visibility while required conditions are absent.
